headline: Continued hearings for 11 Cote Lane and 354 West Sutton Road; ratified enforcement order for fill at 320 Putnam Hill Road.
summary: Public hearings for 11 Cote Lane and 354 West Sutton Road were continued at the applicants' request. Full certificates of compliance were approved for 234 Manchaug Road and 355R Boston Road, and a minor change was accepted for Wedgewood Farm/ Armsby Road. A member recommended that an update on 72 Main Street be provided by 8/4/26.
decisions: Continued the public hearing on the resource area delineation at 11 Cote Lane, 4-0-0.
Continued the public hearing on the Notice of Intent for 354 West Sutton Road, 4-0-0.
Tabled approval of the minutes from 7/22/26, 4-0-0.
Approved payment of $642.00 in MACC FY 2027 dues, 4-0-0.
Approved payment of $50.00 in MSMCP FY 2027 dues, 4-0-0.
Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for DEP # 303-0424 at 234 Manchaug Road, 4-0-0.
Approved a full Certificate of Compliance for DEP # 303-0191 at 355R Boston Road, 4-0-0.
Approved an Extension Order of Conditions for DEP # 303-0866, Manchaug Pond aquatic restoration, 4-0-0.
Accepted the minor amendment to DEP # 303-0905, Wedgewood Farm/ Armsby Road, 4-0-0.
Ratified the amended enforcement order for fill at 320 Putnam Hill Road, requiring fill removal, erosion controls, and restoration, 4-0-0.

transcript:
## SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

**Meeting Minutes**

**August 5, 2026**

Approved [signature]

Pursuant to Governor Healey's directive extending the temporary Open Meeting provisions until June 30, 2027, the Conservation Commission meeting will be conducted in a HYBRID format and will be recorded. *Recordings will be available on the Town's website and YouTube channel. *Please be aware: Participants attending via Zoom will have their video and audio disabled. *If you wish to engage in discussion, raise your hand; if acknowledged by the Chair, you will receive a pop-up message allowing you to unmute yourself. For agenda, YouTube, and Zoom links, please visit http://suttonma.gov/467/Communications-Cable-TV.

**Present in person:** William Wence, Chair (WW); Michael McGovern, Vice-Chair (MM); James Marran (JM); Jared Duval (JD)

**Present by Zoom:** Timothy Thompson (TT)

**Also present:** Sarah Fortune, Conservation Agent (SF); Brandon Faneuf, Consultant (BF); Jared Moore & Jared Legassey, 320 Putnam Hill Road; Antea Alexander, 72 Main Street; Raouf Mankaryous, Alpha Omega Engineering

Unavailable: N/A

## Public Hearings/Meetings

### 1. 6:00 pm – Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation (ANRAD): 11 Cote Lane

Raouf Mankaryous, Alpha Omega Engineering was present at the hearing. SF reported that she reviewed the wetland delineation on 7/30/26 and confirmed the wetland flagging and found no issues nor needed to revise the flagging. DEP provided file comments requesting that the extent of Riverfront Area associated with the perennial stream be evaluated as part of the delineation. R. Mankaryous requested a continuation of the public hearing.

**Motion:** to continue the public hearing

1st - JM; 2nd – JD

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### 2. 6:00 pm – Notice of Intent (NOI): 354 West Sutton Road

Interns for Civil Site Engineering c/o Margaret Bacon were in attendance to present the project which consists of a single family home development with associated facilities. Stormwater management includes plantings, vegetated swales and a rain garden. SF inquired about the grading at the roadway, as the site plan appears to show that the grading will result in stormwater being discharged onto the roadway; she requested that the driveway grading be revised to be reverse-graded so that stormwater is not discharged onto the roadway. JD added that the road is a scenic road governed by the Scenic Road bylaw. JM added that tree removal is proposed within the 50-foot Buffer Zone to Bordering Vegetated Wetlands (BVW) so a planting plan is required, per the bylaw. DEP has not issued a file number. The representatives requested a continuance.

**Motion:** to continue the public hearing

1st - MM; 2nd – JD

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

## Board Business

### 1. Approve Minutes from 7/22/26

**Motion:** To table the approval of the minutes from 7/22/26

1st - MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### 2. Bills Payable

a. MACC FY 2027 dues - $642.00

**Motion:** To approve the payable

1st - MM; 2nd - JD

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

b. MSMCP FY 2027 dues - $50.00

**Motion:** To approve the payable

1st - MM; 2nd - JD

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### 3. Certificates of Compliance

a. DEP # 303-0424: 234 Manchaug Road – MM read Request for Certificate of Compliance letter into the record. SF performed the final site inspection, recommended the issuance of a full Certificate of Compliance

**Motion:** to issue a full Certificate of Compliance for DEP # 303-0424, 234 Manchaug Road

1st – MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

b. DEP # 303-0191: 355R Boston Road – MM read Request for Certificate of Compliance letter into the record. SF performed final inspection, recommended the issuance of a full Certificate of Compliance.

**Motion:** to issue a full Certificate of Compliance for DEP # 303-0191, 355R Boston Road

1st – MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### Extension Requests:

1. DEP # 303-0866: Manchaug Pond aquatic restoration

**Motion:** to issue an Extension Order of Conditions

1st – MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### Project Review Requests:

1. DEP # 303-0905: Wedgewood Farm/ Armbsy Road – notification of minor project change

Brian Waterman of WD Design group was present to discuss the notification of minor project change. The Commission agreed that the amendment was minor. BF was in agreement.

**Motion:** to accept the minor amendment

1st – JM; 2nd - JD

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

### Enforcement Issues:

1. 72 Main Street: Mr. & Mrs. Alexander; B. Faneuf update. Property surveyed by the Town of Douglas area of pool, patio, tree cutting and gravel in the town of Douglas in land owned by the town of Douglas Conservation Commission. Approx. all of area in Sutton in jurisdiction of SCC. Douglas issued E.O. and will most likely file injunction against homeowner. B. Faneuf read in E.O. issued by Sutton Con Com. BF reported that at this time, it appears that the activity in Sutton consisted of tree removal, but stated that he has not been hired by Sutton to evaluate the extent of the violations, whereas he has been retained by Douglas to provide said service. JM recommended that that an update be provided by 8/4/26 to show progress towards development of a restoration plan, even if it is a phone call or email to the SCC.

2. 320 Putnam Hill Road: J. Legassey, J. Moore, Bob Murphy; Brandon/Sam did site visit to confirm B. Murphy wetland line. Trenching w/machinery on site reviewed soil samples( fill approx. 4-5' deep in wetland) to determine actual wetland line. Line updated w/ no objection from B. Murphy (onsite). BF reported that there is cut and fill in an Isolated Vegetated Wetland (IVW) which is jurisdictional under the local Wetlands Protection Bylaw only. Bob Murphy stated that all gravel fill will be removed until parent soils are found, erosion controls will be installed around the restoration area, and then plantings will be installed in the restoration area. J. Legassey stated he would like to move the fill within the next week or 2 and he wants to create lawn and install a garage. JM stated that there is a minimum 50-foot setback from the resource area, as stated in the previous meeting. MM stated that the fill needs to be pulled back to the 50-foot Buffer Zone line from the wetland boundary to the area that's already disturbed, then install erosion sediment controls and conduct restoration. MM continued to state that after restoration has been achieved, then a Notice of Intent can be filed for the garage. BF read Bob Murphy's memo into the record. BF wants to see where the existing tree line is on the restoration plan, and JM wants to see the soil stockpile area with erosion controls shown on the restoration plan. BF stated that the SCC voted to amend the Enforcement Order, and recommended that the SCC ratify that, and it will not affect the directives as discussed previously.

**Motion:** To ratify the amended Enforcement Order to require the removal of fill, installation of erosion sediment controls, and conduct restoration with tree plantings and plant seed mix.

1st – MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

**Adjournment:** Motion to adjourn at 7:40 PM

1st – MM; 2nd - JM

Vote: 4-0-0 – WW-yes; MM – yes; TT– yes; JM – yes; JD – yes

No Further Discussion

Motion Carries

Sincerely submitted,

Sarah Fortune, Conservation Agent

Sutton Conservation Commission
